name: Ramp out of slow motion
description: Begin in slow motion, smoothly accelerate to natural action speed halfway through, then hold natural speed. Keep the same action and camera path.

prompt.default: Begin in slow motion, smoothly accelerate to natural action speed halfway through, then hold natural speed. Keep the same action and camera path.
prompt.kling: Begin in slow motion, smoothly accelerate to natural action speed halfway through, then hold natural speed. Keep the same action and camera path. Apply the speed change to the subject's motion, without a camera cut.

prompt.veo: Begin in slow motion, smoothly accelerate to natural action speed halfway through, then hold natural speed. Keep the same action and camera path. Show a smooth temporal transition with consistent subject identity.
